run_upload_gtest: run upload_gtest.py to upload a Google Test patch for review with the mailing group CC'd
run_upload_gtest_with_cc: run upload_gtest.py with custom --cc flags to add extra reviewers to the patch upload
review_main: review the main function that wraps upload.py and auto-appends the Google Test group to the CC list
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional default CC recipients beyond the Google Test group
summarize_upload_gtest: summarize the upload_gtest.py wrapper script that passes CLI args to upload.py with an auto-added CC address
